name: field
description: One form control with its label, an optional hint, and an error that shows itself when the control is invalid.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: Scales the control's height and text.

attributes.name: data-inline
attributes.description: Put the label beside the control. Checkboxes and radios are inline without it.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: The colour of a checked checkbox or radio.

children.description: The label, with for pointing at the control's id. Required unless the field is a fieldset with a legend.
The legend, when the field is a fieldset grouping several controls.
The control slot as an affix: a control with attachments, or two controls joined.
Help text, referenced by the control's aria-describedby.
The error message, hidden until the control is invalid.

tokens.name: --yeti-field-gap
tokens.description: Space between label, control, and hint.

tokens.name: --yeti-control-border
tokens.description: Border of the control at rest.

a11y.notes: The label's for must match the control's id; the validator checks it. Reference the hint and the error from the control with aria-describedby so both are announced. Use aria-invalid="true" for errors found on the server. The required marker is decoration; the required attribute is what assistive tech reads. A switch is a checkbox with role="switch"; its label reads as the switch's name. A range needs a label like any control, and aria-valuetext when the numbers are not what a person would say.
